channel.title: The Nevada Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Nevada Independent (thenevadaindependent.com)

item.title: OPINION: Supporting voter ID doesn’t make the SAVE Act a good idea
item.description: As recently as 2021, the GOP was insistent that elections remain primarily run by the states, objecting vehemently to the Democratic attempt to “strengthen voting rights” after the commotion and chaos of the 2020 election.

item.title: Nevada compensa a mujer quien fue condenada por aborto espontáneo bajo una antigua ley
item.description: Una mujer fue acusada bajo una ley, exclusiva de Nevada, que penaliza el consumo de medicamentos para interrumpir un embarazo después de 24 semanas de gestación.

item.title: Do candidates for Congress have to live in their district?
item.description: Find out in our latest fact brief.

item.title: OPINION: As a sex worker, I’m better off as an entrepreneur — not an employee
item.description: As an independent contractor, I’m not just a sex worker, I’m an entrepreneur. Going from a business owner to an employee doesn’t feel like empowerment to me — it feels like regression.

item.title: Nevada prison system OT continues to spiral; officers criticize state leaders
item.description: Leaders from Nevada’s correctional officers union bemoaned the prison system’s widespread staffing shortages and worsening overtime payouts, pointing fingers at everyone from the governor’s office to state lawmakers.

item.title: Reporte: 16 aseguradoras de Nevada descartan ilegalmente solicitudes de servicios de salud mental
item.description: Un legislador cuestionó cómo se puede considerar a la salud mental como de segundo nivel con respecto a la salud física.

item.title: A’s to launch a limited personal seat license program to help fund share of $2B stadium construction
item.description: Less than 20 percent of the ballpark’s 30,000 seats will be included in the plan, which will cover “premium seats.”

item.title: Will Lombardo-backed measure affecting trans athletes make it to ballot? Judge weighs suit
item.description: Carson City Judge Jason Woodbury threw out an effort from supporters of the initiative to dismiss the lawsuit on the grounds that the naming of certain defendants was illegal. But he did not issue a ruling on the lawsuit itself.

item.title: IndyTalks: Cortez Masto calls Trump admin ‘racist,’ hints at future political plans
item.description: Nevada’s senior senator also answered questions on the Epstein files and the 2028 presidential race in a conversation with Nevada Independent CEO Jon Ralston.

item.title: Senadora por Nevada Catherine Cortez Masto califica de ‘racista’ al gobierno de Trump
item.description: Durante evento en Reno, la senadora Demócrata también respondió preguntas sobre los archivos Epstein y la contienda presidencial 2028.
